20–60 s per area
2–5 min per hand or foot
3. For how long
30–90 s in place
30–90 s per ear
30–90 s per area
4. Warning signs
60–120 s per area
60–180 s per area
: Gently press with your thumbs the muscle at the base of the neck, to the side of the spine, not on it.
: Press with your fingers both sides of the nose, next to the nostrils, in small circles.
: Press with your index fingers on the sides, below the cheekbones, in small circles.

: With your index and middle fingers, holding steady pressure, press the upper edge of the shoulder blade, toward the neck (TE15), and the muscle above the spine of the shoulder blade (SI12), at the same time.

: With your thumbs press into the hollow below the middle of the spine of the shoulder blade (SI11) and the upper edge of the shoulder blade, toward the neck (TE15), on the muscle, on both sides at once, with steady pressure.
: With your thumbs, in small circles, press the low back muscles next to the sacrum, both sides at once.
: Press with your fingers the jaw, on the side, where you feel the muscle when you clench your teeth, then open your mouth slightly.
: Press with your thumb the wrist crease, on the little-finger side and in the middle.
: Press with your thumb the muscle between the thumb and index finger, holding and breathing slowly.

: Press with your thumb the muscle next to the crest of the shinbone, three finger-widths below the kneecap (ST36), then the hollow below the inner edge of the bone, below the knee (SP9); do not press on the bone, with steady pressure.
: Press with your thumb the point next to the little-finger joint on the side of the hand, then switch hands.
: Press with your thumb into the hollow in the front third of the sole and hold, breathing slowly.
: Press the top of the head with your middle finger, then gently massage the scalp toward the nape.
: Press the muscle between the thumb and index finger, then the wrist, on each hand.
: Press on the top of the foot, near the outer edge, in the hollow beyond where the bones of toes 4 and 5 meet (GB41), with moderate pressure.
: With your thumbs, press both sides of the wrists at the same time, and the muscle between the thumb and index finger.
: Press below the knee, to the side of the shinbone, then on the inner side of the lower leg.
: Press below the knee, to the side of the shinbone, then the sole, each foot, 20–30 seconds.
: Press the temples in small, gentle circles, on both sides at once.
: Press lightly below the navel, with two fingers, on the midline, without forcing.
: Press and make small rotations between the eyebrows, then to the side of the nose.
: Lightly touch the scalp with your fingertips, with small circular movements, like a fine drizzle.
: Place both warm palms on the abdomen and breathe deeply 4–5 times, letting the belly expand.

: Place the ball on the muscle next to the spine, at the level of the upper edge of the pelvic bones (iliac crest), well below the last ribs and below the kidney area; bend the knees slightly and let your weight press gently.
: Place your palms on your face, then stroke toward the nape; finish with 3 slow breaths.
: Place your palms on your shoulders and stroke from the neck toward the tips of the shoulders, 6–8 times.
: Gently tap the thighs and buttocks with a cupped palm (not on the hip bone).
: Move the ball down to near the edge of the sacrum and roll in small movements, only on the muscle next to the bone, without pressing on the sacral bone; skip this step during pregnancy.
: Continue at mid-back level, on the muscle, without moving down onto the flanks below the ribs.
: With both thumbs press gently into the two hollows below the kneecap, on either side of the patellar ligament (the “eyes of the knee”).
: With both hands stroke the sole and the top of the foot, from the toes toward the ankle.
: With both palms stroke the abdomen in a circle, clockwise; then touch lightly above the navel, without pressing deeply.
: With both palms stroke the leg upward from the ankle toward the knee and then toward the hip, 8–10 times.
: With your index and middle fingers press at the same time on the bones below the eyes and on the sides of the nostrils, without touching the eyeball.
: With your index and middle fingers on each side, gently press to the side of the navel, simultaneously, breathing slowly.
: With your index and middle fingers on each side, press the temples and the area above the ears at the same time, in small, gentle circles.

: With the elbow bent, press with your thumb at the outer end of the elbow crease (LI11), then three finger-widths lower, on the forearm muscle (LI10); do not press at the middle of the crease (vessels and nerve), holding steady.
: With your thumbs gently press at the same time the inner corners of the eyebrows, on the bone above the eye, not on the eyeball.

: With your thumbs press lightly, one after the other, on the inner wrist: in the hollow on the little-finger side (HT7), then in the middle, three finger-widths above the crease (PC6), holding steady.
: With your thumbs press the area at the base of the skull, upward, without pressing on the side of the neck.
: With your thumbs press, on both sides of the spine (not on it), at the same time, from top to bottom, on the muscle.
: With your thumbs rub the sole in long strokes, from the heel toward the toes.
: With your thumb press the center of the palm, then massage the palm in wide circles.

: With your thumb or the heel of your hand, press gently on the side of the buttock, in the hollow next to the hip (GB30), on a single point, on each side; if you feel tingling or pain in the leg, stop.
: With your middle finger press the top of the head, and with the other fingers the surrounding points, holding steady pressure.
: With your middle finger press and make small rotations between the eyebrows, with your eyes closed.
: With your middle finger press and make small rotations between the eyebrows, breathing slowly.
: With two fingers press lightly above the navel, halfway between the navel and the sternum, holding and exhaling slowly.
: With the opposite hand make small circles in the hollow below the middle of the spine of the shoulder blade, on the muscle, then switch sides.

: With one hand press the hollow between the inner ankle bone and the Achilles tendon (KI3), and with the other the one between the outer ankle bone and the tendon (BL60; skip during pregnancy), holding steady, with light to medium pressure.
: With the opposite palm stroke the forearm from the wrist toward the elbow, on the front and the back, 6 times.
: With a cupped palm, give very light taps on the trapezius muscle on the shoulders (not on the neck, collarbone or shoulder blade), then pause.
: With the whole palm, without weight, make wide, slow circles on the abdomen, always in the same direction.
: With warm palms and oil, stroke the back broadly, from bottom to top along the sides of the spine and back down along the flanks.
: With your palms stroke the forehead slowly toward the temples, then from the forehead toward the nape, 6–8 times, breathing slowly.
: With your palms gently stroke the face, from the center outward, 6 times.
: With your palms gently roll and rub the back in long strokes, from the hips toward the shoulders.

: With the leg supported, gently shake only the foot, without pulling, then rotate the ankle 5 times in each direction; skip the shaking if you have a herniated disc, sciatica, a prosthesis or varicose veins.

: With the pads of your thumbs and index fingers, gently move the skin along the eyebrows, from the nose toward the temple, without pinching or pulling the skin; keep the pressure on the eyebrow bone, not toward the eye.
: With your fingertips gently rotate the muscles next to the cervical spine, not on it, from top to bottom.
